company_info.industry_info: Banking and Financial Services. BMO Financial Group is one of the largest diversified financial services providers in North America with C$1.5 trillion in total assets. The company is the 8th largest bank in North America measured by assets.
company_info.recent_news: BMO Financial Group reported strong Q2 2026 results with net income of $2,630 million compared to $1,962 million in the prior year, and Q1 2026 results with net income of $2,489 million. The company continues to focus on deepening client relationships, innovating to drive business value, and optimizing performance under CEO Darryl White.
company_info.company_culture: BMO fosters a supportive and collaborative culture with a strong emphasis on diversity and inclusion. Glassdoor rating is 3.8 out of 5 stars based on 9,061 reviews, with 67% of employees recommending the company. Employees appreciate the collaborative atmosphere and strong emphasis on collaboration, though some reviews highlight a disconnect between management and employees.
company_info.any_related_information: BMO is committed to an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace and offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, retirement savings plans, and opportunities for professional development through training, coaching, manager support and network-building. The company has a global footprint with operations in 30+ locations. BMO does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiting agencies without a valid written contract.
